# Generated by tools/cm_generate_proximity_finder.py - do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate after a game update.

# Country scope. Land-cost reduction from the best unlocked road, the best
# roads assumed built everywhere: 20 (verified in game; the
# road_cost_on_distance_from_capital modifier is unused) plus the road type's
# proximity field.
cm_pf_road_reduction_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_advance = railroad_advance }
		add = 35 # 20 + railroad proximity 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_advance = modern_road_advance }
		add = 30 # 20 + modern_road proximity 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_advance = paved_road_advance }
		add = 25 # 20 + paved_road proximity 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_advance = road_building }
		add = 20 # 20, gravel_road has no proximity field
	}
}

# Location scope. Expects scope:cm_pf_capital (the country's capital), when it
# exists. Terrain-impact adjustment for a capital candidate: a location sharing
# the current capital's topography loses the capital-in-topography benefit it
# currently enjoys (proximity times the impact the capital grants).
cm_pf_cap_adj_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:cm_pf_capital
			topography = mountains
			scope:cm_pf_capital = { topography = mountains }
		}
		add = -0.1 # mountains proximity -0.5 times the 0.2 capital-in-topography impact.
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:cm_pf_capital
			topography = hills
			scope:cm_pf_capital = { topography = hills }
		}
		add = -0.05 # hills proximity -0.25 times the 0.2 capital-in-topography impact.
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:cm_pf_capital
			topography = plateau
			scope:cm_pf_capital = { topography = plateau }
		}
		add = -0.025 # plateau proximity -0.125 times the 0.2 capital-in-topography impact.
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:cm_pf_capital
			topography = wetlands
			scope:cm_pf_capital = { topography = wetlands }
		}
		add = -0.05 # wetlands proximity -0.25 times the 0.2 capital-in-topography impact.
	}
}

# Location scope. Terrain-impact gain when the candidate capital shares this
# location's topography (the mirror of cm_pf_cap_adj_value for the new capital).
cm_pf_capb_extra_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { topography = mountains }
		add = 0.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = hills }
		add = 0.05
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = plateau }
		add = 0.025
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { topography = wetlands }
		add = 0.05
	}
}
